vte_events.poolable_reason: THREE LIMBS DIFFER AT ONCE. Read from ClinicalTrials.gov 2026-08-18: NCT01181102 is PROPHYLAXIS of venous thromboembolism in ADULTS after total knee or hip replacement, against ENOXAPARIN. NCT02798471 (Hokusai) is TREATMENT of CONFIRMED venous thromboembolism in CHILDREN, against STANDARD OF CARE. Averaging a prophylaxis trial with a treatment trial is not a pool of one question -- the event being counted means a different thing in each, because in one the thrombosis has not happened yet and in the other it already has. The populations differ (adults post-surgical against children) and the comparators are not the same agent. Edoxaban is correctly the experimental arm in both, so the INTERVENTION limb passes; participants and comparator do not.

vte_events.what_this_verdict_does_not_establish: NOT that the trials are poor -- each is registered, randomised and reports its primary. NOT that the drug is ineffective. NOT that no poolable question exists in this area -- only that the one this page's title asks cannot be answered by pooling the trials on it.
vte_events.poolable_DEPRECATED_note: `poolable` MEANT ONLY 'the source page pooled these trials'. It was never a judgement that the pool was sound, and the renderer read it as permission to assert 'pooled on the X scale'. RENAMED to source_page_pooled, which is what it says. `poolable` is retained so nothing breaks, and it is DEPRECATED: read source_page_pooled for what the source did, and estimand_established for whether the pool is defensible. A PAGE SHOULD DISPLAY A POOLED ESTIMATE BECAUSE ITS ESTIMAND WAS ESTABLISHED, NOT BECAUSE SOMEONE ONCE POOLED IT.
vte_events.estimand_established_means: TRUE only where every contributing trial has been READ and shown to measure the same quantity, or the same construct with a variance stated. FALSE where that was checked and failed. NULL where it was never checked -- AN ABSENT ASSERTION AND A NEGATIVE ONE ARE DIFFERENT STATES and null is not a pass.
vte_events.estimand_established_does_not_cover_the_: READ THIS BESIDE `estimand_established`. That flag records that every contributing trial measures the SAME QUANTITY. It records NOTHING about what that quantity was measured AGAINST -- whether the comparators are of one kind, whether each comparison was randomised, whether it was concurrent. On attr-pn-review the flag is TRUE and correct while the pool combines patisiran against its own saline placebo, vutrisiran against PATISIRAN, and eplontersen against the placebo cohort of a DIFFERENT TRIAL. The two questions were never separated. Named as P48 in PAGE-STANDARD.md v1.21.0 and swept by scripts/audit_mixed_contrast_pools.py.
